Anyone on AWS can assume this role; so can cloud services.

  Anyone            unknown               No grant is placed with people who have no account anywhere.
  Anyone on AWS     exact    grant 3      Anyone on AWS can assume this role; no condition confines callers to one account or organisation.
  A named outsider  exact    grant 4      aws:111122223333 can assume this role and is not declared as yours.
  Your pipelines    exact                 No grant is confined to owners declared as yours.
  Your people       exact                 No grant trusts a SAML provider declared as yours.
  ──
  Cloud services    unknown  grants 1, 2  Any cloud service can assume this role; which ones, and for whom, is not read.

Each of these can narrow the rings and was not read: the organisation's resource control policies, the calling accounts' service control policies and this account's identity providers.
